title: Game Server Configuration
description: Schema for validating server-side TOML configuration files.

tcp_host.description: The TCP binding address and port.

udp_host.description: The UDP binding address and port.

max_players.description: Maximum number of simultaneous player connections.

resources.description: A list of resource packages to load on startup.

disable_VoIP_server.description: Whether to disable the built-in Voice over IP server.

connection_host_addr.description: Public server address that would be used to connect via server list

secret_token.description: Servers's private token that is used to identify servers in server list
